newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May trade balance due Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May trade balance due Tuesday.

text.p: Brazil's Ministry of Industry and Commerce will release the trade balance figure for May on Tuesday, a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said no time had been set but noted the figures were usually disclosed at 1100 local/1000 EDT/1400 GMT. No news conference was expected to take place.
Brazil posted a $78 million trade deficit between May 1 and May 25.
Analysts polled by Reuters expect May's final result to be a deficit of about $200 million, which would be Brazil's lowest monthly trade gap in about seven months.
